contentHtml:
Hi everyone,

We wanted to share a short update on what is currently happening at Double Heart Games.

Our main focus right now is RUBEZH // Archive 86, an analog horror observation game where you monitor surveillance cameras, identify anomalies, and report them before things get out of control. The Steam page is currently going through review, while we continue working on the first playable demo.

We are also preparing My Little Sticker Book for release and continuing development on several other projects, including Pizza for the President, The Great Little Journey, and future games in the Art-Therapy series.

ːpinkheartː My Little Sticker Book is already on Steam, you can wishlist it while we prepare the release.

We have recently updated our website as well, making it easier to see our current games, upcoming projects, older experiments, and playable demos.
https://doubleheartgames.com/

More updates will follow as individual projects reach important milestones.

Thanks for following Double Heart Games!
